title: Contrato: La Escuadra de Sombras
description: Elimina a la guardia personal de Caballeros Caídos del Fell King que asolan los caminos.

title: Gran Cacería: El Rey Caído
description: El soberano de la oscuridad ha despertado. Marcha a su trono y derrota al Fell King Boss.

title: Cataclismo: Ignis, el Titán de Fuego
description: En las profundidades ardientes del Nether duerme el coloso de la llama eterna. Destruye a Ignis.

stages.description: Derrota a Ignis en la Arena Abisal

title: Cataclismo: Monstruosidad de Netherita
description: La mayor aberración de metal y magma forjada en las profundidades. Destroza a la bestia acorazada.

title: Cataclismo: El Presagio Mecánico
description: Una máquina de guerra ancestral patrulla las ruinas del fin. Apaga sus reactores.

title: Tormento: El Lich de la Torre Nocturna
description: El hechicero inmortal de las torres en ruinas manipula las almas frías. Purgad su torre.

title: Cacería Feroz: Las Fauces de Hielo
description: En las tundras heladas duerme un gigante de nieve con cuernos de carámbano. Despiértalo y arranca su cuerno.

title: Contrato: La Bestia de la Cueva
description: Un peligroso arácnido acecha en las profundidades. Neutraliza la plaga y limpia el sector.

stages.description: Rastrea el sector del nido en la cueva

title: El Poder de las Gemas de Apotheosis
description: Las gemas antiguas imbuyen armas y armaduras con poderes divinos. Consigue una gema engarzable.

stages.description: Consigue una Gema de Apotheosis en tu inventario

title: Armamento de la Guarnición
description: Los arqueros de la muralla necesitan munición y arcos frescos. Fabrica arcos para la armería.

title: Suministros de Acero
description: Extrae mineral de hierro crudo de las profundidades de la cantera.

title: Pesca en Aguas Claras
description: Consigue pescado fresco para el abastecimiento de la taberna.
rewards: 1x Caña de Pescar de la Suerte

title: Ingredientes de Brujería
description: Elena necesita verrugas del inframundo y botellas de agua para sus pociones de curación.

title: Raciones para las Tropas
description: Cocina y hornea pan caliente en los hornos de la plaza para los heridos.

stages.description: Cocina 8 Panes o Comida en horno

title: Expedición Botánica
description: Busca especímenes vegetales silvestres en las profundidades del bosque.

title: Localizar una Aldea
description: Confirma la presencia y posición de asentamientos civiles en las llanuras.

stages.description: Entra al perímetro de una Aldea

title: Contrato: Emboscada en la Ruta
description: Saqueadores asaltan los suministros cerca del cruce. Acude al lugar y repele la emboscada.

stages.description: Elimina a los saqueadores de la emboscada

title: Contrato: Encargo del Gremio
description: Demuestra tu valía limpiando esqueletos. (Bloqueado si ya completaste el contrato del Tabernero).

title: Contrato: Resiste la Oleada
description: Aguanta 45 segundos dentro del perímetro mientras llegan oleadas de no-muertos.

title: El Camino del Mago
description: La magia arcana despierta en estas tierras. Consigue un Grimorio de Aprendiz y pon a prueba tu poder contra los creepers.

title: Los Tomos Perdidos
description: Necesito restaurar el archivo de la aldea. Tráeme libros y gemas de fuente.

title: Rutas Olvidadas
description: Traza los alrededores localizando una torre de saqueadores cercana.

title: Contrato: Purgación de la Horda
description: Los caminos están infestados. Limpia zombis, esqueletos y arañas.

title: Caza Nocturna
description: Los Endermen merodean al caer la noche. Tráeme pruebas de su derrota.

title: The Adventure Begins!
description: Cisco sensed a familiar power within the champion. Believing they may be able to aid him in his quest to defeat the fell king he offered his guidance. Relive the champion's journey and ascent to legendary status.

title: The path of the warrior
description: Up close and personal.

title: Novice spell caster
description: Source can be manipulated in almost infinite ways limited only by your creativity and the glyphs available to you. To do this you will need to craft a spell book. It can later be dyed in your favourite color.

title: The path of the mage
description: It is time to begin your spell caster training. The are two main origins of magic in the world, one uses a resource called "source" and the other uses "ambient mana" present within the world and it's living creatures. Which path will you choose?

title: Obtain iron
description: Iron is a key component in many recipes and is vital early on in your adventure.

title: The relic of the ancients
description: There is a tale of a legendary relic which lies in the possesion of the villagers. Perhaps if you can gain their favor they may entrust it to you?

title: Misión 068B6D
description: Here is where you craft the glyphs used for spell casting. With each new glyph your maximum mana increases slightly.

title: Amplified Magics
description: This glyph increases the potency of many other glyphs when used in tandem in a spell.

title: Aquire Obsidian
description: Aquire obsidian and craft a nether portal.

title: The depths of Hell
description: The Nether is filled with large structures and powerful enemies, prepare carefully before entering.

title: Acquire Quartz
description: Quartz is needed for some important recipes like upgrading to a tier 2 spellbook.

title: Rank up your magic
description: Upgrading your spell book will allow you to cast more powerful spells.

title: Find the an ancient runic tablet
description: These can be found in dungeon chests.

title: Aquire an enchanting table
description: This will be your second main source of power. Master the apotheosis enchanting system and even weaker tier gear can become godly.

title: For Glory!
description: Embrace the light.

title: All shall kneel...
description: Embrace the darkness.

title: Misión 441A82
description: Netherite ingots are a crucial part of many complex item recipes and as such you will need a fair amount of it. Pickaxes with powerful enhantments or certain dungeon chests are great ways to get more of it.

title: Misión 5FFC0E
description: The eye of flame can be used to locate the burning arena home to the Flame King Ignis.

title: Slay the terror of the nether
description: Gatekeeper The nether star obtained from slaying the Wither is used in the crafting of very powerful items. The wither will grow in strength every time you defeat it.

title: Slay the flame king
description: Gatekeeper Acquire burning ashes from ignited revenants guarding the burning arena. Use the ashes on the altar in the center of the arena and extinguish The King of Flames.

title: Not gold but certainly glitters
description: Amethyst is another key ingredient in all things arcane and you may need quite alot of it. Thankfully you can automate its production using the Amethyst Golem familiars.

title: Apothic Enchanting
description: Apotheosis allows you to enchant your gear far beyond what you are used to. It may take some configuration but eventually you will be able to fashion gear that makes you unstoppable.

title: Collecting the 12 eyes
description: The 12 eyes needed to ignite the end portal can be found in dungeon chests all over the world , in the nether, as well a few of them needing to be crafted. These three are a good starting point.

title: Enter the End Dimension
description: It is now time to face the Dragon.

title: Slay the Ender Dragon
description: Gatekeeper Not even the Ender Dragon can stand before your might . Slay her and liberate the end dimension. Each time you battle her she will grow  in strength.

title: Misión 2504D1
description: The eye of the void is used to locate the ruined citadel where the powerful Ender Guardian resides.

title: Slay the Ender Guardian
description: Gatekeeper Can you conquer this powerful foe?

title: The Greatest Magician
description: Upgrage your spell book to the final tier by combining it with the rarest of materials.

title: Misión 438D84
description: Summon the Wilden Chimera and defeat him to obtain the wilden tribute. This can be done using the ritual brazer , a tablet of summon wilden and the 3 types of wilden drops.

title: Misión 0F7160
description: The final form of the sword of justice .

title: Misión 00CB68
description: The final form of the sword of darkness.

title: Misión 5A24E1
description: Starbuncles are crucial to automating source production which is needed for all things ars nouveau . Interact with a wild starbuncle by feeding it gold nuggets and use the fragment to craft its charm.

title: Craft the Ignitium set
description: Ignitium Armor is indestructible and provides various effects such as lava walking.

title: Misión 74C563
description: You can grind gems to gem dust here which is used to imbue your gear with special affixes via the reforging table.

title: Misión 28B406
description: This is where you reforge your gear. Reforging adds stats and sockets for gems to your equipment based on the quality of reforging materials used. Can be upgraged further.

title: Misión 78C3CC
description: This reforging table allows you reroll up to mythic tier affixes.

title: Misión 5319E4
description: You can store enchantments here for later use. Can be upgraded further.

title: Misión 1436BC
description: The ultimate enchantment library.

title: Misión 7519AF
description: Potion charms are very powerful items which can give you a potion effect permanently when in your inventory. By default they lose durability whilst active but you can make them unbreakable by enchanting them with a certain amount of quanta , eterna etc refer to your recipes.

title: View skill tree
description: The skill tree will allow you customise your character and gain the strength required to face the challenges that await. Default key is (o). Click the checkmark to complete the quest.

stages.description: Habla para completar View skill tree

title: Misión 7B1FA4
description: A combination of metals and nonmetals enhanced with magic this resilient metal is used to craft many different weapons and armor.

title: Brightsteel Armor
description: Brightsteel Armor provides good protection and a small resistance buff when healthy.

title: Gilded Eagle
description: The Gilded Eagle armor set provides medium protections but bonus and speed and the ability to breifly dodge incoming attacks.

title: Misión 6853D0
description: This multitool fashioned with brightsteel will greatly aid in the acquisition of natural resources.

title: Slay Spiders
description: The spider population has grown out of hand, reduce thier numbers.

title: Misión 553D2E
description: Used to store and retrieve experience levels.

title: Adventurers Garments
description: Craft the Adventurer's Armor and continue your journey.

title: Craft the brightsteel pickaxe
description: This highly efficient pickaxe is second only to the darksteel variant.

title: Misión 5F0BBB
description: The darksteel pickaxe uses ancient magic to enhance the users strikes increasing efficiency to unparralled levels.

title: Slayed Betrayed Guzzler
description: Demons born of the seven deadly sins have found their way into our world. They pose a significant danger and must be dealt with quickly. Rumors are they only spawn at night.

title: Misión 7916F8
description: To begin your study of ambient magic you will need to craft a spell book. More powerful spellbooks can be found in dungeon chests , aquired from slaying enemies or crafted with very rare materials.

title: Acquiring Ink
description: Before you are able to inscribe your spell into your spell book you will need ink. These can be found in chests at different rarities but easily found from mage towers and defeating the wizards within.

title: Misión 1713C0
description: With the ink you have collected you will also require a table to do the inscription. The inscription table can be easily crafted or "borrowed" from a mage structure.

title: Use Gems to increase spell power
description: Gems which increase spell power when socketed in the correct pieces of gear can significantly boost your magic damage output. You may only socket one gem of the archmage into your chestplate so it is recommended to use one of the highest quality available. Multiple source jewels may be socketed in thier respective pieces of gear however , which can provide stacking increases to damage.

stages.description: Habla para completar Use Gems to increase spell power

title: Socketing Gems
description: Socketing gems into your equipment will boost the respective power of that magical school. The main way to find these gems would be within dungeons throughout the world.

title: Misión 609257
description: The arcane anvil has multiple uses with the main being the combination of two scrolls of the same rarity into higher tier versions of themselves.

title: The ultimate Spell Book
description: The ancient codex is the most powerful spell book and can be crafted with very rare materials.

title: Click the the checkmark.
description: Spells can be found throughout the world in dungeons and mage towers in the form of scrolls. These scrolls are single use only but can and should be inscribed into a spellbook to use repeatedly.

stages.description: Habla para completar Click the the checkmark.

title: Misión 526D9E
description: The darksteel variant of the brightsteel multitool unrivalled in speed an efficiency.

title: Visit Ocean Monument
description: Ocean monuments can be found within ocean biomes.

stages.description: Habla para completar Visit Ocean Monument

title: Slay the Elder Guardian
description: Gatekeeper The Elder Guardian is a powerful creature which guards the ocean monument. You can obtain the guardian eye required for opening the end portal from killing it.

title: Darksteel Armor
description: Darksteel Armor provides superior overall protection with added defence against especially lethal hits. It also grants a permanent resistance buff.

title: Misión 3AF40C
description: This table uses sigils of enhancement to further increase the power of your reforged affixes.

title: Find a bounty board
description: The bounty board allows you  to accept and complete small tasks in exchange for rewards. They can usually be found in villages.

stages.description: Habla para completar Find a bounty board

title: Find a village
description: The villagers may be able to aid you in your journey  providing resources in exchange for protection. Seek out a village.

stages.description: Habla para completar Find a village

title: Misión 6C3BF7
description: This reforging table allows you reroll up to esoteric tier affixes.

title: Misión 0A9E8B
description: This reforging table allows you reroll up to ancient tier affixes.

title: Misión 7815C7
description: This useful tool will help you find any biome you desire.

title: Visit the twilight forest
description: This portal can be crafted with flowers and dirt and will take you to the twilight forest.

title: Acquire Naga's Head
description: Can be found in Naga's Courtyard.

title: Acquire Lich's Head
description: Can be found in the lich's tower.

title: Acquire Minoshroom's Head
description: Can be found at the bottom of the Labyrinth.

title: Acquire the Hydra's Head
description: Can be found in it's lair in a fire swamp.

title: Acquire Knight Phantom's Head
description: Can be found in a large room inside of the Goblin Knight Stronghold.

title: Acquire the Ur-Ghast's Head
description: Can be found at the top of the Dark Tower.

title: Acquire the Alpha Yeti's Head
description: Can be found in it's lair in the snowy forest.

title: Acquire the Snow Queen's Head
description: Can be found at the top of the Aurora Palace.

title: Craft the explorer's compass
description: This item will help you locate structures in your world.

title: Visit keep kayra
description: Raid this massive keep and take it's treasures.

stages.description: Habla para completar Visit keep kayra

title: Raid Shiraz Palace
description: Clear out this massive palace structure filled with powerful enemies and loot.

stages.description: Habla para completar Raid Shiraz Palace

title: Raid Bastille
description: Clear out this fortified pillager camp.

title: Raid the Dungeon Crawl Dungeon
description: This massive dungeon may appear small on the surface but houses many floors which get harder but more rewarding as you descend.

stages.description: Habla para completar Raid the Dungeon Crawl Dungeon

title: Visit the aether dimension
description: Visit the dimension in the sky.

title: Find the bronze dungeon
description: The first of the three dungeons in the aether.

stages.description: Habla para completar Find the bronze dungeon

title: Find the silver dungeon
description: Find the the silver dungeon and slay valkyries to obtain victory medals.

stages.description: Habla para completar Find the silver dungeon

title: Find the gold dungeon
description: The last of the dungeons within the aether .

stages.description: Habla para completar Find the gold dungeon

title: Defeat the slider
description: This boss can be found in the bronze dungeon. Must be defeated using pickaxes or shovels.

title: Slay the Valkyrie Queen
description: After obtaining 10 victory medals you may challenge the valkyrie queen.

title: Slay the Sun Spirit
description: The sun spirit resides in the gold dungeon once slain the aether will no longer be in a a state of perputual daytime.

title: Craft a backpack
description: The backpack is an item that holds items and can be carried with the player. It has numerous utility upgrades and can be expanded all the way from standard to netherite tier for even more extra storage.

title: Misión 39ADA7
description: This utility upgrade allows the user to store stacks of items in the same slot. Can be upgraded from 2 stacks all the way to 16.

title: Misión 22388F
description: This utility upgrade allows the backpack to to become indestructible.

title: Misión 1972EE
description: This ultility upgrade allows for smelting within the backpack. This function can be upgraded further.

title: Misión 2DCCC1
description: This utility upgrade allows for crafting within the backpack.

title: Misión 513C6A
description: This utility upgrade allows the backpack to automatically feed the player with items from thier inventory.

title: Craft the iron furnace
description: Furnaces can be upgrade by combining them with rare metals.

title: Craft the golden furnace
description: The gold furnace boasts faster cook speed than the iron and can be upgraded even further .

title: Misión 2754C9
description: This station will act as stone cutter for wood allowing you to obtain many different variants.

title: Stone Wand
description: Building wands will allow you to build large structures quickly and effieciently.

title: Misión 452481
description: Building wands can be upgrade from stone tier to infinity tier. Cores may also be combined with wands to increase functionality.

title: Easy Villagers Auto Trader
description: You may place a villager with an occupation into the autotrader selecting the items you wish to trade. The auto trader will then automate that trade.

title: Easy Villagers Trading
description: You may place a villager with an occupation within the trader to gain easy access to thier trades whenever you require.

title: Easy Villagers Iron Farm
description: You may place a villager into the iron farm to begin automatically farming iron.

title: Easy Villagers Farmer
description: You may place a farmer villager and seeds within the farmer to automate crop farming.

title: Easy Villagers Converting
description: The converter automatically converts villagers to zombie villagers then back into regular villagers. This process decreases their trade prices and requires you to input a villager , golden apple and any potion of weakness.

title: Easy Villagers Breeding
description: The breeder requires you two input two villagers and a food item to then produce baby villagers.

title: Easy Villagers Incubator
description: The Incubator increases the growth rate of baby villagers.

title: Find the Olympic Citadel
description: The olympic Citadel was once believed to be the home of gods now abadoned after they were almost completely wiped out by Fell King Arthas and the fell forces.

stages.description: Habla para completar Find the Olympic Citadel

title: Visit the Nether
description: The Nether dimension has been enhanced now featuring a more varied and atmospheric version with new landscapes and challenges.

title: Travel to the End
description: The End dimension has undergone a massive transformation, turning it into a vibrant, more diverse, and visually stunning world.

title: Visit the Soul Plain
description: The Soul Plain  is a desolate, eerie landscape filled with dark, ghostly elements. It features a twisted, haunting environment with a purple-gray palette, and is often inhabited by hostile mobs like Soul Eaters.

title: Find the Platinum dungeon
description: Find the platinum dungeon, within lies your final foe the aerwhale king.

stages.description: Habla para completar Find the Platinum dungeon

title: Defeat the Aerwhale King
description: Residing atop the platinum dungeon the aerwhale king is a formiddable foe. Defeat him and claim the platinum key.

title: Visit the Bone Reef
description: The Bone Reef underwater-like environment found within the Nether. It features large, bleached bone structures that resemble a vast coral reef, with bones and skeletons scattered throughout. The biome has a haunting aesthetic, often filled with hostile mobs like Bone Sharks and other skeleton-themed creatures.

stages.description: Habla para completar Visit the Bone Reef

title: Visit the crimson glowing woods
description: The Crimson Glowing Woods is a vibrant and eerie area filled with towering crimson trees that emit a soft, glowing light. The landscape is dominated by dense forests of these glowing trees, with the ground covered in crimson-colored grass and fungi.

title: Visit the dead upside down forest
description: The Upside Down Forest is a surreal landscape where the trees grow inverted, with their roots reaching toward the sky. The forest is filled with dead, twisted trees and a haunting atmosphere, as the ground is covered in withered foliage and dark vegetation.

title: Visit the flooded deltas
description: The Flooded Deltas is a murky, waterlogged area within the Nether. The terrain is covered in pools of dark, stagnant water and is filled with jagged, often submerged rocks and volcanic features. The biome's atmosphere is gloomy and treacherous, with hostile mobs like Sludges and other water-adapted creatures lurking in the depths.

title: Visit the Amber Land
description: The Amber Land biome  is one of the more visually striking and immersive areas within the revamped End dimension. It’s a rich, warm colored biome that feels like stepping into a completely different realm within the End, full of both beauty and mystery.

title: Visit the Blossoming Spires
description: The Blossoming Spires biome is a stunning and ethereal landscape characterized by towering spires of glowing, crystalline structures and vibrant, floating flora. The biome is filled with Blossoming Trees that have delicate, colorful petals, and the ground is covered in lush, flower-filled grass.

title: Visit the Chorus Forest
description: The Chorus Forest biome is a mystical and vibrant landscape, featuring towering Chorus Trees that grow in dense clusters, their twisted branches covered in glowing Chorus Flowers. The biome is filled with a variety of Chorus-like vegetation, giving it a surreal, otherworldly appearance.

title: Visit the Crystal Mountains
description: The Crystal Mountains biome  is a breathtaking, jagged landscape dominated by towering, glittering Crystal Spires and massive, crystalline formations. The ground is dotted with Crystal Shards and rich veins of Endstone Ore, glowing with various colors that reflect off the crystals scattered throughout the area.

title: Visit the Dragon Graveyards
description: The Dragon Graveyards biome is a haunting, eerie area filled with the remains of ancient dragons. The biome is characterized by vast, desolate landscapes littered with Dragon Bones, massive Skeletons, and crumbled dragon skulls that serve as eerie reminders of a forgotten time.

title: Misión 4B4BF1
description: Knowlwedge keeps you alive. A Bestiary contains information about most of the magical creatures you may encounter possibly granting you a combat advantage. The manuscripts you will need can be found within chests in caves , dragon roosts or graveyards.

title: Misión 2FB157
description: The Bestiary Lecturn will allow you add chapters to your bestiary by combining it with manuscripts.

title: Misión 57F0E5
description: Silver is a metal that can be found on the same level as gold and can be used to create tools and armor which are especially effective against undead.

title: Misión 779907
description: The Ice dragon summoning crystal is an item that can teleport a ice dragon to you. To do so, use on a dragon to bind it and after, use when bound to teleport the dragon . After usage, the crystal will be unbound to the dragon and therefore you must use on the dragon again to rebind the crystal. Crystals are bound to a dragon when a black dragon silhouette appears on the crystal.

title: Misión 4E213C
description: The lightning dragon summoning crystal is an item that can teleport a lightning dragon to you. To do so, use on a dragon to bind it and after, use when bound to teleport the dragon . After usage, the crystal will be unbound to the dragon and therefore you must use on the dragon again to rebind the crystal. Crystals are bound to a dragon when a black dragon silhouette appears on the crystal.

title: Befriend a pixie
description: Pixies are small magical creatures that glow in the dark and may attempt to steal your items. They are found in pixie villages and can be captured  with a jar or befriended with cake. They also give special buffs respective to thier colour.

stages.description: Habla para completar Befriend a pixie

title: Tame a Hippocampus
description: Hippocampi are aquatic creatures with the head of a horse and the body of a fish which can be found swimming within the ocean and deep ocean biomes. They can be tamed with kelp and bred with prismarine crystals.

stages.description: Habla para completar Tame a Hippocampus

title: Tame a Hippogryth
description: Hippogryphs are half eagle half horse hybrids that usually live on mountains. They can be tamed with 8 rabbit feet and bred with rabbit stew.

stages.description: Habla para completar Tame a Hippogryth

title: Kill a Dread Lich
description: There is a dark fortress lurking within cold biomes that houses great rewards but equally powerful foes. In order to gain entry you will need to obtain the gravemasters key  which drops from dread liches. Dread liches can also be found within cold biomes.

title: Find the Mausoleum
description: This impenetrable fortress must be accessed with the gravemasters key. Deep within you will find a partially incomplete ice dragon forge which can be repaired and used to make dragonsteel.

stages.description: Habla para completar Find the Mausoleum

title: Slay Fire Dragons
description: Fire dragons can be recognised by thier colours which range from fiery red , emerald green , bold yellow or smoky black. Fire dragons usally linger around any biome above -0.5 degrees in temperature except jungles, savannahs and badlands. Stages 1-3 prefer roosts on the surface , whilst stages 4-5 lurk in caverns underground.

title: Slay Lightning Dragons
description: Lightning dragons can be recognised by their colours which range from amethyst purple, dark black copper brown or electric blue. Lightning dragons can only be found in jungle , savannah and badlands biomes and are nocturnal creatures. Stage 1-3 lightning dragons are usually found in roosts on the surface whilst stage 4-5 are found underground in caverns.

title: Slay Ice Dragons
description: Ice dragons can be recognised by thier colours which range from icy blue , gem blue , silver white or snowy white. Ice dragons can usually be found in cold biomes ranging from -0.5 degrees in temperature and below. Stage 1-3 dragons prefer roosts on the surface , whilst stage 4-5 dragons lurk in subterrean caverns .

title: Misión 6B949C
description: The fire dragon summoning crystal is an item that can teleport a fire dragon to you. To do so, use on a dragon to bind it and after, use when bound to teleport the dragon . After usage, the crystal will be unbound to the dragon and therefore you must use on the dragon again to rebind the crystal. Crystals are bound to a dragon when a black dragon silhouette appears on the crystal.

title: The Cyclops
description: The cyclops is a giant humanoid creature that can usually be found in the cyclops cove and savannah biomes. It's eye can be damaged with projectiles to make the fight easier.

title: The Gorgon
description: The Gorgon is a half human half serpent creature capable of petrifying it's victims with it's gaze. It will also attempt to poison and weaken you. Should you fight it,  an equipped blindfold will greatly aid you.

title: The Hydra
description: The Hydra is a powerful multiheaded serpent which can be found in the hydra lair exclusive to swamp biomes. It is recommended to fight it with fire damage to avoid it regenerating and growing new heads.

title: Tame a Dragon
description: Wild dragons cannot be tamed. However upon slaying one you may obtain an egg that you can hatch to tame one for yourself. Fire dragon eggs must be hatched in fire or lava. Ice dragon eggs must be hatched in water surrounded by ice. Lightning dragon eggs must be hatched exposed to rain.

stages.description: Habla para completar Tame a Dragon

title: Fallen Heroes
description: Long after the deaths of Cisco and the mysterious hero who helped him defeat Fell King Arthas, the  conflict continued between the descendants of Arthas and Cisco. The conflict lasted for hundreds of years before Cisco's descendant Arthur made a bold move in marrying Arthas' descendant Sylvi combining their bloodlines to end the conflict.

title: Alexander
description: Arthur and Sylvi's son would inherit a power so great that he could warp reality and bend time itself. He would use his power to unite all the known realms under his fair and just rule. He lived for hundreds of years de-aging himself when he got too old increasing the chaotic temporal energy within himself.. This however would impact anyone who got too close to him stealing thier "time" and causing them to rapidly age eventually into dust. This made him severly lonely and one day leaving instructions on how to rule to his heir he flew up into the sky and released all the temporal energy back into the world ending his own life in the process.

title: Draconic Era
description: The released temporal energy would have disastrous effects on the world empowering once docile magical creatures , resurrecting ancient beasts, empowering existing hostile creatures and creating pockets underground where time would behave differently. One such magical beast was the Dragon. Once passive docile creatures they became aggresive and began to hunt humans attacking thier settlements. With the power in the blood of humans diluted and weakened through the ages none could stand against the threat they posed. Until..

title: Misión 32E7D9
description: The eye of the lightning dragon can be crafted using lightning  dragon blood and ender pearls and used to locate lightning dragons in the same way you would locate a stronghold.

title: Misión 50D030
description: The eye of the fire dragon can be crafted using fire  dragon blood and ender pearls and used to locate fire dragons in the same way you would locate a stronghold.

title: Misión 428212
description: The eye of the ice dragon can be crafted using ice  dragon blood and ender pearls and used to locate ice dragons in the same way you would locate a stronghold.

title: Misión 630C84
description: This relic can be used to command tamed dragons to wander stay or follow you. It can also be set a home for tamed dragons.

title: Craft Dragonsteel
description: Once you have completed a dragonforge you may begin crafting dragonsteel by placing dragon blood within the forge and having a stage 3 - 5 dragon use thier breath attack on it. Dragonsteel can be used to craft powerful tools and armor that will aid you in slaying even more powerful dragons.

title: Craft dreadsteel
description: Dreadsteel is the most powerful material that can be forged to combat dragons. Armor forged with dreadsteel provide incredible defense and resistances whilst weapons forged in dreadsteel are unmatched in lethality.

title: Craft Dreadsteel Armor
description: Dreadsteel Armor provides immunity to damage from fire ,lightning and spikes making it especially good against dragons.

title: Misión 031859
description: This weapon is capable of firing armor piercing projectiles which can easily keep up with dragons flying and high speeds.

title: Misión 635DD0
description: This shield incinerates incoming projectiles and burns melee attacks when blocking.
